agents.name: 📝 Qualidade de Código
agents.prompt: This is a code review for a NestJS REST API project (TypeScript). Focus on TypeScript idioms, NestJS patterns, Kysely usage, class-validator DTOs, async correctness, dependency injection, naming conventions and test coverage.

agents.name: 🏗️ Arquitetura
agents.prompt: This is an architecture review for a NestJS REST API project. Focus on module boundaries, dual database pattern (Kysely vs TypeORM), vision scope enforcement, SSRM engine usage, controller/service separation, and coupling between domain modules.

agents.name: 🔒 Segurança
agents.prompt: This is a security review for a NestJS REST API project. Focus on JWT/Cognito authentication, vision scope authorization, input validation, SQL injection via Kysely/TypeORM, secret exposure, OWASP Top 10, and secure coding practices. If no security-relevant code was changed, confirm that briefly.

agents.name: ⚡ Performance
agents.prompt: This is a performance review for a NestJS REST API project. Focus on Kysely query efficiency, TypeORM N+1 problems, async/await misuse, SSRM pagination correctness, memory leaks in services, RabbitMQ message handling, and caching opportunities.

agents.name: 🔗 Consistência
agents.prompt: This is a consistency review for a NestJS REST API project. Identify patterns that were applied in one place but not in similar locations across the repository. Focus on partially applied fixes, DTOs changed without all usages updated, vision scope applied inconsistently, and divergent styles within the same PR.
